name: Nan Juen International Co., Ltd.
summary: Nan Juen International Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and trading of steel ball guide rails in the United States, Asia, Europe, Africa, and internationally. It offers residential, RV, industrial, appliance, toolbox, and server slides; office furniture; kitchen spaces; and loading products. The company was formerly known as Nan Juen Industrial Corporation and changed its name to Nan Juen International Co., Ltd. in September 1996. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan. Nan Juen International Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Repon Industrial Corporation.
